LESSON: READING 14.2.1 STUDY SKILLS: SUMMARISING

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 14
Topic 14.2: Reading 14.2.1 Study Skills: Summarising
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 14.2.1 Study Skills: Summarising, part of Strand 14 in Grade 7 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to summarise information? 2. What factors should one consider when summarising an event?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.
